section_summary.extract_value: This concluding section states that the (single) study provides preliminary evidence that variation in body/appearance-related social exposure influences young women's body image, with exposure to non-body-focused others uniquely contributing to more adaptive outcomes. It notes benefits may be experienced the same day and may carry over to the next day, and suggests promoting inclusion of more non-body-focused individuals to protect against maladaptive eating and body image patterns. The section repeatedly refers to "this study" (singular) and provides no methodological or sample details.
section_summary.evidence_source: Although preliminary in nature, the results of this study highlightthe importance of developing a broader body of research... Given that exposure to non-body focused and body focused others contributed uniquely to outcomes, women may experience benefits from trying to interact with more non-body focused individuals... Furthermore, the benefits of doing so may be readily experienced on that same day and even carry over to the next day.
